shipping_and_economics_check.question: Is Etsy shipping customer-paid separately, or free/included in the retail price?
shipping_and_economics_check.method: Read all 10 Printify-created Etsy shipping profiles on shop 67844439, then confirmed against a live listing produced by this exact pipeline.

positive_control.conclusion: Printify sets the Etsy customer shipping charge ABOVE its own fulfillment shipping cost. It does not absorb shipping into the merchandise price.

shipping_and_economics_check.decision_rule_applied: Branch 1 - customer is charged shipping separately, so merchandise retail stays at 27.99. No reprice.

margin_classification.explicitly_excludes: the 5.49 US fulfillment shipping (recovered separately from the buyer) AND all Etsy marketplace fees (listing, transaction, payment processing, offsite ads). This figure is NOT margin after shipping and fees.
margin_classification.floor_test: 55% pre-marketplace-fee gross margin floor - PASS with 7.2 points of headroom

counterfactual_recorded.if_shipping_were_free_included_at_27.99: 42.55% - would breach the 55% floor, which is why branch 2 exists
counterfactual_recorded.note: Branch 2 was not triggered. Flagging for the record only: 35.99 would cross the common Etsy 35.00 free-shipping-guarantee threshold, so if that shop setting is ever enabled, a 35.99 price could itself convert shipping to free and re-open this question.

shipping_and_economics_check.residual_to_verify_at_publish: Blueprint 485 has no Etsy shipping profile yet; Printify creates or assigns one at publish. The blanket precedent above shows Printify sets it at or above its own fulfillment shipping cost, so 5.49 is expected to be covered. The created profile's actual US primary cost will be read back and confirmed >= 5.49 before LIVE_VERIFIED is declared.
